statusDetail: Coverage-complete remote audit across six representative public templates/journeys. Authenticated creation, checkout payment submission, and private account settings were not covered because they require credentials or consequential transactions.

page.framework: Server-rendered multi-page application with JavaScript/canvas activity runtime
page.notes: Public marketing/listing/form/pricing pages are server-rendered; activity metadata is server-visible but the playable quiz is client-enhanced.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The light and dark emulation screenshots are visually identical; computed html/body color-scheme is normal and the surface remains light.
Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the media query matched and getAnimations() returned no active animations on the home path.
The forced-colors/prefers-contrast screenshot preserves text, controls, borders, and visible focus coloration.
The platform probe found no view-transition usage and route changes are conventional full-page swaps.
No scroll-linked motion was present on the representative public templates, so there is no scroll animation implementation to assess.
checkOutcomes.reason: No scroll-linked motion was present on the representative public templates, so there is no scroll animation implementation to assess.

checkOutcomes.evidence: The activity uses large direct tap/click targets and native page scrolling; no custom swipe or pointermove interaction fought platform behavior.
The DOM reports a fixed header but no scroll-state/container-query behavior; the chrome does not react to page position.
The responsive navigation is manually fixed (computed position: fixed) and the CSS probe found no anchor-positioning behavior for edge-aware menus.
Persistent labelled navigation, activity title, selected template state, and clear page headings orient the user across sampled templates.
Load screenshots across home, community, login, pricing, and activity show content immediately with no obscuring interstitial.
No modal, disclosure, picker, or transient rich overlay was required in the sampled core paths.
checkOutcomes.reason: No modal, disclosure, picker, or transient rich overlay was required in the sampled core paths.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Desktop and mobile screenshots devote the main viewport to purpose, activity, or pricing content with restrained global chrome.
The activity layout at 360px reported scrollWidth 366 vs clientWidth 360, a 6px horizontal overflow.
The platform/CSS probe found zero @container rules across the home surface; adaptation relies on global viewport media queries.
Programmatically focusing the first link produced outline: none and no box shadow; Lighthouse also failed target-size.
The first viewport states “More teaching, less prep” and exposes a prominent “Sign Up To Start Creating” action; the activity exposes a large START control.
The public activity reaches its launch screen without an account wall and the active click probe advances it to the loading state.
Submitting the empty login form left both controls valid and returned no validation/error/live-region content, while neither field is required.
Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 4.7 s, FCP 4.1 s, Speed Index 5.3 s, and TTI 7.9 s (performance 0.71).
Observed CLS was 0.025 on home and 0.099 on the interactive activity, both within the good <=0.1 range.
The trace recorded zero long tasks and 0 ms total blocking time; Lighthouse TBT was 47 ms.
HAR measured 85 requests and 2.58 MB transferred with 10 parser-inserted render-blocking stylesheet candidates; images and fonts contributed 1.91 MB.
Lighthouse estimated 169 KiB unused JavaScript, including large waste in two Google tag bundles and the first-party global bundle.
Lighthouse failed image-alt and link-name; the page probe found 18 images without alt, and several activity icon buttons have neither text nor aria-label.
Lighthouse failed the color-contrast audit on both home and login representative templates.
The focused home link had no outline or shadow; homepage heading sequence contains four H1 elements and no main landmark was found.
Desktop and mobile screenshots show readable headings and body text without clipping on the sampled home, login, pricing, and activity templates.
Viewport metadata fixes maximum-scale=1.0; Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and target-size on home and login.
Lighthouse errors-in-console audit passed with an empty error list on the home page.
Lighthouse failed image aspect ratio; the image probe found all 34 images lacked explicit width/height.
The login Lighthouse run reported three BFCache failure reasons and missing source maps for large first-party JavaScript.
Home, login, pricing, and activity probes each returned descriptive titles and meta descriptions.
Rendered navigation uses real href links; viewport metadata is present; robots.txt permits public pages and names the sitemap.
Neither home nor the sampled activity exposed link[rel=canonical], despite stable public URLs; robots and sitemap were otherwise consistent.
Home includes WebSite JSON-LD and Open Graph metadata; the activity includes two JSON-LD blocks and article Open Graph metadata matching visible content.
HTTPS and HSTS are present, but CSP and nosniff are missing; both first-party cookies are non-Secure with SameSite=None.
The tracker capture found five third-party origins and active Google Tag Manager/Analytics; HAR attributed 2.55 MB to non-main origins.
The sampled login offers password and Google sign-in but no visible passkey/WebAuthn path; no permission prompt fired on load.
Headers lack CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy.
Discoverability found only 30% raw-HTML content coverage for the activity; its interactive quiz requires JavaScript and the crawler view lacks the playable core task.
Menus and activity controls remain within the sampled desktop/mobile viewport; the activity’s template chooser and launch state render coherently.
The app-like activity/creation site exposes no web app manifest and navigator.serviceWorker.controller was false.
A deliberate unknown route produced a clear 404 heading, explanatory text, Contact action, and persistent site navigation.
The document declares lang=en and dir=ltr, and the UI exposes dozens of languages including Arabic and Hebrew.
Pricing renders a labelled GBP amount and the site exposes explicit language/location controls instead of ambiguous unlabeled numeric data.
The sampled public pages expose no date, event, or scheduling data for which time-zone or DST handling applies.
checkOutcomes.reason: The sampled public pages expose no date, event, or scheduling data for which time-zone or DST handling applies.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Pricing clearly states monthly cost, annual discount, cancellation, resumption, billing timing, and account consequences in the visible FAQ.
Empty login submission produced no inline, summary, aria-live, or browser validation feedback; email/password fields are not required.
Login email and password inputs expose empty autocomplete attributes rather than username/current-password tokens.
The pricing path shows Basic, Standard, and Pro commitments before Subscribe and explicitly documents cancellation and post-cancellation access.
All 34 inspected images use legacy PNG/JPG, 23 below-fold images are not lazy, eight are oversized, and ten lack srcset.
Trace and layout observers found no long tasks or continuing main-thread work during the sampled load window.
The 2.58 MB homepage load includes 2.55 MB from non-main origins, 616 KB fonts, 1.29 MB images, and 284 KB Google tag scripts.
This public marketing, discovery, and quiz surface does not declare an agent-facing capability or WebMCP intent; the emerging check is judged out of scope.
checkOutcomes.reason: This public marketing, discovery, and quiz surface does not declare an agent-facing capability or WebMCP intent; the emerging check is judged out of scope.

checkOutcomes.evidence: No user task on the sampled public paths requires on-device inference; the emerging opportunity is judged out of scope.
checkOutcomes.reason: No user task on the sampled public paths requires on-device inference; the emerging opportunity is judged out of scope.

checkOutcomes.evidence: Baseline/post interaction heap summaries changed from 26.94 MB to 27.84 MB and only 11 nodes, a bounded ~3.3% delta with no monotonic-growth signal in this exercise.
The interactive activity heap was 27.84 MB with about 1,104 live DOM elements, proportionate to a canvas/game surface.
Baseline/post summaries showed only 11 additional heap nodes and no Detached* constructor among the largest retained constructor populations.

principleOutcomes.reason: The emerging agent-facing capability and on-device inference checks do not apply to the sampled public marketing/discovery/quiz scope without declared agent intent.

paths.description: Homepage/marketing template and primary acquisition entry; tested desktop, mobile, dark, reduced-motion, high-contrast, performance, network, security, accessibility, discoverability, and image delivery.
Community listing/index archetype and route discovery; represents resource search/browse.
Public resource detail plus primary interactive quiz launch; tested desktop/mobile, no-JS discoverability, launch interaction, layout, and memory.
Authentication/form archetype; tested labels/autofill, invalid empty submission, Lighthouse accessibility/performance, and visible layout.
Commercial decision template; tested pricing clarity, cancellation/continuity copy, hierarchy, metadata, and subscription calls to action without making a purchase.
HTTP/application recovery archetype using a deliberately unknown URL.

findings.summary: No system-driven dark theme
findings.evidence: Dark emulation is visually identical to light and computed color-scheme remains normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and retint surfaces/text through prefers-color-scheme or light-dark().

findings.summary: Route and state swaps do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: The probe found no view-transition usage; navigation uses conventional page swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Add cross-document view-transition-name for stable chrome and same-document transitions for activity state where motion adds orientation.

findings.summary: Fixed chrome does not respond to scroll state
findings.evidence: Header is fixed, but no scroll-state/container-query behavior was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state queries or a lightweight progress/shrinking treatment to preserve context without consuming static space.

findings.summary: Menus use fixed/manual positioning rather than anchor positioning
findings.evidence: Computed navigation positioning is fixed and no anchor-positioning rules were found.
findings.suggestedFix: Anchor transient menus to their trigger and provide position-try fallbacks at viewport edges.

findings.summary: Activity overflows the narrow viewport
findings.evidence: At 360px, activity scrollWidth is 366px against a 360px client width.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the residual fixed/min width and use intrinsic sizing so the activity shell never exceeds 100vi.

findings.summary: Components do not use container-level adaptation
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found zero @container rules; adaptation is viewport-only.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type on reusable cards/activity panels and size-aware container rules where their available width varies.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible and some targets are undersized
findings.evidence: Focused first link computed to outline none and no box shadow; Lighthouse failed target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a strong :focus-visible treatment and enlarge/space compact links and icon controls to at least a comfortable touch target.

findings.summary: Login errors are not surfaced on empty submission
findings.evidence: Empty submission left email/password valid and produced no error or live-region message.
findings.suggestedFix: Make required state explicit, validate after interaction, focus the summary/first invalid field, and announce actionable errors.

findings.summary: Homepage LCP is slow under mobile Lighthouse
findings.evidence: LCP was 4.7s, FCP 4.1s, Speed Index 5.3s, TTI 7.9s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP visual, defer below-fold media and noncritical fonts/scripts, and verify LCP below 2.5s.

findings.summary: Heavy request graph delays initial content
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 85 requests, 2.58MB, and 10 parser-inserted stylesheet candidates; fonts/images total 1.91MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline or consolidate critical styles, defer noncritical CSS/fonts, preload only the actual LCP resource, and enforce caching.

findings.summary: The page ships substantial unused JavaScript
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 169KiB unused JavaScript across tag-manager and first-party bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Conditionally load analytics and route-specific code, then split or remove unused global code.

findings.summary: Images, links, and activity icon controls lack accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image-alt/link-name; probe found 18 images without alt and unnamed activity buttons.
findings.suggestedFix: Give meaningful images alt text, decorative images empty alt, and every icon-only control an accessible name.

findings.summary: Text contrast fails on key templates
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed color contrast on both home and login.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/surface tokens to meet WCAG AA in every interaction state.

findings.summary: Focus and document structure are not robust
findings.evidence: Focused links are invisible, home has four H1s, and no main landmark was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one page H1, logical subheadings, a main landmark, and persistent :focus-visible indicators.

findings.summary: The viewport blocks user zoom and touch targets fail sizing
findings.evidence: maximum-scale=1.0 is set and Lighthouse failed meta-viewport and target-size.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale/minimal-ui restrictions and enlarge/space compact targets while preserving 320px reflow.

findings.summary: Image sizing and aspect-ratio hygiene is weak
findings.evidence: Lighthouse failed image aspect ratio; all 34 inspected images omit width and height.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit width/height or aspect-ratio for every image and preserve intrinsic aspect ratios.

findings.summary: Login is not BFCache-clean and source maps are missing
findings.evidence: Login Lighthouse reported three BFCache failure reasons; large first-party JavaScript lacked valid source maps.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove avoidable BFCache blockers and publish production source maps with controlled access.

findings.summary: Stable public pages omit canonical links
findings.evidence: Home and sampled activity probes found no rel=canonical, while robots and sitemap expose stable URLs.
findings.suggestedFix: Add self-referencing canonical URLs and keep them consistent with sitemap and Open Graph URL signals.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie flags are incomplete
findings.evidence: CSP/nosniff are absent; both cookies are non-Secure and SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy an enforced CSP, nosniff, and Secure cookies with the narrowest viable SameSite/HttpOnly policy.

findings.summary: Analytics and non-main origins dominate the request surface
findings.evidence: Five third-party origins include GTM/GA and HAR attributes 2.55MB to non-main origins.
findings.suggestedFix: Load analytics only after the appropriate consent/context, reduce duplicate tag paths, batch events, and document data purpose.

findings.summary: Authentication has no visible passkey path
findings.evidence: The login path offers password and Google sign-in but no passkey/WebAuthn option.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration/authentication as a phishing-resistant option while retaining a recovery path.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policy coverage is sparse
findings.evidence: No CSP/frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy is returned.
findings.suggestedFix: Set frame-ancestors, nosniff, strict Referrer-Policy and a least-privilege Permissions-Policy; evaluate Trusted Types.

findings.summary: The playable activity is not progressively available
findings.evidence: Raw HTML coverage is only 30% and the quiz core task is absent from the no-JS crawler rendering.
findings.suggestedFix: Server-render the activity prompt/options or provide a meaningful no-JS fallback before enhancing with the interactive game runtime.

findings.summary: The app-like experience has no install/offline surface
findings.evidence: No manifest is linked and there is no controlling service worker.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a web app manifest and a small service-worker offline shell/fallback for saved or launched activities.

findings.summary: Login validation gives no humane recovery guidance
findings.evidence: Empty submission yielded no inline, summary, aria-live, or browser validation feedback.
findings.suggestedFix: Validate after interaction, explain each correction in plain language, and announce/focus errors accessibly.

findings.summary: Login fields omit autofill tokens
findings.evidence: Email and password inputs have empty autocomplete attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=username and autocomplete=current-password, with visible labels retained.

findings.summary: Homepage imagery is oversized and not responsively delivered
findings.evidence: 34/34 images are legacy formats, 23 below-fold images are eager, eight oversized, ten without srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate AVIF/WebP variants, responsive srcset/sizes, lazy-load below-fold images, and right-size source dimensions.

findings.summary: Media, fonts, and tag scripts consume a disproportionate budget
findings.evidence: 2.58MB includes 1.29MB images, 616KB fonts, and 284KB Google tag scripts.
findings.suggestedFix: Set per-template budgets, subset fonts, defer below-fold media, and conditionally load analytics.

taskList.title: Restore inclusive keyboard, naming, contrast, zoom, and target behavior
Add CSP and defensive headers; secure and narrow cookie policy
Optimize responsive media and critical delivery to bring LCP below 2.5s
Implement humane, labelled, autofill-friendly login validation
Provide meaningful no-JS and offline fallback for activities
Fix activity mobile overflow and adopt container-aware component sizing
Correct asset dimensions, canonical URLs, BFCache blockers, and source maps
Modernize navigation motion, scroll state, and anchored overlays
